command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== STEP 1: create backing store and keyfile =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/luks-keys
sudo -n install -m 000 /dev/null /etc/luks-keys/secure.key
sudo -n bash -c 'head -c 4096 /dev/urandom > /etc/luks-keys/secure.key'
sudo -n chmod 400 /etc/luks-keys/secure.key
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/luks-keys/secure.key

sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/luks-volumes
sudo -n fallocate -l 2G /var/lib/luks-volumes/secure.img
sudo -n chmod 600 /var/lib/luks-volumes/secure.img

echo "== STEP 2: luksFormat with keyfile =="
sudo -n cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 --batch-mode /var/lib/luks-volumes/secure.img /etc/luks-keys/secure.key

echo "== STEP 3: get UUID =="
LUKS_UUID=$(sudo -n cryptsetup luksUUID /var/lib/luks-volumes/secure.img)
echo "LUKS_UUID=$LUKS_UUID"

echo "== STEP 4: open, format filesystem =="
sudo -n cryptsetup luksOpen /var/lib/luks-volumes/secure.img secure --key-file /etc/luks-keys/secure.key
sudo -n mkfs.xfs -f -L secure /dev/mapper/secure

echo "== STEP 5: crypttab entry =="
sudo -n cp /etc/crypttab /etc/crypttab.bak 2>/dev/null || sudo -n touch /etc/crypttab
sudo -n sed -i '/^secure /d' /etc/crypttab
echo "secure /var/lib/luks-volumes/secure.img /etc/luks-keys/secure.key luks,nofail" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/crypttab

echo "== STEP 6: fstab entry =="
FS_UUID=$(sudo -n blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/mapper/secure)
echo "FS_UUID=$FS_UUID"
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/secure
sudo -n cp /etc/fstab /etc/fstab.bak
sudo -n sed -i '\#/srv/secure#d' /etc/fstab
echo "UUID=$FS_UUID /srv/secure xfs defaults,nofail 0 2" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab

echo "== STEP 7: mount now to verify, then unmount/close to test clean boot path =="
sudo -n mount /srv/secure
sudo -n bash -c 'echo hello-encrypted > /srv/secure/testfile'
sudo -n ls -la /srv/secure
df -h /srv/secure

echo "== STEP 8: unmount + close + reopen via systemd generator path (simulate boot) =="
sudo -n umount /srv/secure
sudo -n cryptsetup luksClose secure
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl start systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service
sleep 1
sudo -n mount /srv/secure 2>&1 || echo "mount not auto after manual start, trying local-fs target"
sudo -n systemctl status systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service --no-pager || true
ls -la /srv/secure || true
cat /srv/secure/testfile 2>/dev/null || true
